headword: セルロースファイバー
reading: せるろーすふぁいばー

definitions.explanation: An insulation material made mainly from recycled paper treated to resist fire and pests. Blown into wall and ceiling cavities; noted for good soundproofing and humidity regulation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧セルロースファイバー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吹|ふ}き{込|こ}む→吹き込む：11962_fukikomu⟧。
examples.english: Blow cellulose fiber into the walls.

examples.japanese: セルロースファイバー⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新聞紙|しんぶんし}→新聞紙：20415_shinbunshi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{作|つく}られる→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Cellulose fiber is made from newspaper.

examples.japanese: セルロースファイバー⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{調湿|ちょうしつ}→調湿：29735_choushitsu⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧や⟦{防音|ぼうおん}→防音：14565_bouon⟧⟦{性能|せいのう}→性能：04340_seinou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Cellulose fiber is said to have strong humidity-regulating and soundproofing performance.

notes:
A loanword from English "cellulose fiber." Insulation made from recycled paper (mainly newsprint) treated with fire retardant; valued for soundproofing and humidity control.
